newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Amic sees real increase in year earnings.
newsitem.headline: Amic sees real increase in year earnings.

text.p: Anglo American Industrial Corp Ltd (Amic) said on Wednesday that the group should show real growth in earnings for the full year to March 31, 1998, boosted by good performances within its units.

"All divisions are forecasting an improvement in earnings for the year ending March 31, 1998, and this should translate into an increase in real earnings per share at the group level," Amic said in a statement accompanying half year results.
The industrial group earlier reported a rise in headline earnings to 658 cents from 608 cents before. It raised its dividend to 170 cents from 160 cents previously.
